prior_mechanical_rule.eligible_cell: Sharpe > 0, PF > 1, trade_count >= 20, expectancy >= 80 percent of baseline, and absolute max DD <= baseline in both IS and Validation
prior_mechanical_rule.stable_zone: at least 3 adjacent eligible values in the ordered one-dimensional grid
prior_mechanical_rule.modified_lock: if a stable zone exists, lock its parameter medoid; ties use the lower parameter value
prior_mechanical_rule.baseline_lock: if no stable zone exists, retain the frozen baseline exit

exit_description.target: Two setup-bar ranges projected from the triggered breakout level.
exit_description.stop: Opposite side of the setup bar.
exit_description.time_exit: Cancel unfilled entry orders after the applicable last-entry cutoff; hard-flatten any open position at 16:08. Setups do not carry to the next session.

session_flatten.cash_close_action: No automatic flatten unless exit.time_exit explicitly says cash close.
session_flatten.execution: Exit at the open of the 16:08 one-minute bar. If that exact bar is absent, use the last available close strictly before 16:08. No position may remain afterward.
session_flatten.post_cash_close_monitoring: From 16:00 through hard flatten, accept no new entries or strategy signals; continue monitoring already-known stops and targets on one-minute bars.

early_close_exception.last_entry_time: min(strategy last_entry_time, early close minus 5 minutes)

compression_breakout.justification: Sortie baseline verrouillee explicitement par l'utilisateur.

exit_rule.execution_semantics: Cloturer au prix d'ouverture de la premiere barre 1 minute dont l'horodatage est superieur ou egal a 240 minutes apres l'entree ; le hard flatten conserve la priorite de securite.

volatility_breakout.justification: Time stop 240 minutes verrouille explicitement par l'utilisateur apres revue IS/Validation.

exit_rule.execution_semantics: Stop fixe a 1.0 fois l'ATR Wilder(14) de la derniere barre 15 minutes terminee au moment du fill ; execution intrabar selon les conventions du moteur, avec hard flatten conserve.
